card.title: Adopt the ATLAS UI standards profile in Fitness
card.description: Ratify applicability, baseline current owner UI truth, and extend the existing QA LLEL lane without replacing Fitness tooling.

packets.objective: Use the existing Fitness release-critical QA profile, owner route truth, and deterministic proof lanes to produce the first owner adoption baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Fitness accepts or revises the proposed profile in owner truth.
Applicable routes, states, components, and required controls have a frozen baseline.
Accessibility evidence is added without weakening existing semantic or visual proof.
Owner-produced evidence is root-readable for the target revision.
Any marker is created only after the denominator is accepted.

included: Existing QA adapter and scenario extension

card.title: Adopt the ATLAS UI standards profile in Trove
card.description: Reconcile Trove's existing web_visual QA and Fawxzzy theme adoption with the stable UI standard IDs.

packets.objective: Map Trove's existing web QA and selected shared theme inputs to the standard web profile without making the root theme pack owner implementation truth.
acceptance_criteria: Trove accepts or revises the standard web profile.
Owner routes and components are inventoried at a target revision.
Existing web_visual evidence is correlated to the new standard IDs.
Theme adoption remains an owner decision with explicit compatibility proof.
No marker is inferred from root adapter presence.

included: Existing QA and theme evidence reconciliation

card.title: Select and baseline the ATLAS UI standards profile for Mazer
card.description: Inventory Mazer UI scope and select a profile before any migration or enforcement claim.

packets.objective: Classify Mazer's browser, mobile, game, and release-critical UI surfaces and select the smallest applicable profile with owner evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Mazer UI applicability and release criticality are owner-approved.
Current route or scene surfaces and repo-native proof commands are inventoried.
A profile and denominator proposal are recorded without implementation claims.
Existing production or visual proof is not relabeled as standards adoption without target-revision correlation.
verification: ATLAS QA compatibility report when an adapter is proposed

card.title: Classify ATLAS UI standards applicability for Socials OS
card.description: Determine whether Socials OS has governed UI surfaces and select a profile or explicit not-applicable disposition.

packets.objective: Produce an owner-approved UI applicability decision for Socials OS before any adapter, finding, or marker work.
acceptance_criteria: UI-bearing surfaces are inventoried or an explicit not-applicable decision is evidenced.
The owner selects a profile if UI is in scope.
No analytics or data-system runtime is changed during discovery.
No marker is created before a denominator is accepted.
verification: Socials OS repo-local discovery and verify

card.title: Classify ATLAS UI standards applicability for Stream
card.description: Replace prototype-only root assumptions with an owner-approved applicability and profile decision.

packets.objective: Inventory Stream owner truth and decide whether a visual, shared UI, or not-applicable profile is correct.
acceptance_criteria: Stream owner truth replaces prototype-only root assumptions.
A profile or explicit not-applicable disposition is accepted.
Any adapter proposal wraps repo-native commands.
No adoption claim comes from root prototype files alone.
verification: ATLAS adoption drift readback if an adapter is added

card.title: Classify ATLAS UI standards applicability for Nat1 Games
card.description: Determine the governed UI surface and evidence profile only after the owner repo is ready for inspection.

packets.objective: Establish owner availability, UI applicability, and profile selection without treating the current incubating registration as adoption proof.
acceptance_criteria: Owner repo access and target revision are current.
UI applicability and profile selection are owner-approved.
No remote recovery or product work is folded into standards discovery.
No denominator or marker is inferred from registration status.
verification: Nat1 Games repo-local discovery and verify after owner admission

card.title: Classify ATLAS UI standards applicability for DiscordOS
card.description: Separate any browser-facing DiscordOS UI from the canonical board/publication writer before selecting a profile.

packets.objective: Identify any DiscordOS user interface in scope while preserving its separate single-writer board and publication authority.
acceptance_criteria: UI applicability is separated from board and publication runtime responsibilities.
A profile or explicit not-applicable disposition is owner-approved.
No live board or Discord state changes during discovery.
Any later candidate card is applied only through the DiscordOS writer and readback path.

card.title: Review verified UI failure patterns for Playbook promotion
card.description: Promote only repeated, verified UI failure patterns through KnowledgeCandidate review after owner adoption produces evidence.

packets.objective: Review evidence-backed repeated UI findings and decide whether they become Playbook rules, patterns, failure modes, or rejected candidates.
acceptance_criteria: Each candidate references repeated verified owner findings and exact provenance.
Candidates use atlas.knowledge-candidate.v2 review states.
Raw research and Atlas registry bodies are not copied into Playbook doctrine.
Playbook remains the doctrine owner and Atlas records source-linked adoption only.
dependencies: At least two verified occurrences or one explicitly accepted systemic failure pattern
